title: Review of c46's hunting ecology on fresh seed 13 (256^2): X, predator D and prey E replicate, but no one kind shows I, D and E; most predator daughters fade within ~700 t without another meal
summary: Seed 13 at 256^2 (defaults, t=12000, --lineage-k 5): prey form from noise (54 by t=2000), crash to 5 after predator noise is added at t=2000, recover to 55 by t=5500 and decline to 19 at t=12000 while predators hold at 32-58: one lagged swing. Predator persistent splits 14 (generation 2), prey 1. Matched predator-free twin (seed 13): 79 static prey, 22 persistent prey splits, generation 1, no swing. fate.py on the predator channel (100 t frames): of 66 daughters of 33 predator splits (threshold 0.25), 38 fade below threshold (median life 700 t), 19 reach the end of the run, 7 divide again, 3 grow 1.5x (a meal). Fuel cut at t=6000 (128^2, seed 13): prey 16 -> 0 by t=6600 with the mean prey material kept (0.234 -> 0.233), while the fed twin keeps 16 at t=6400 and 12 at t=6600.

observations.S: pack256/sheet.png t=0: smoothed noise in prey material over the whole box; predator material added as smoothed noise over the whole box at t=2000
observations.I: pack256/sheet.png t=1000-2000 and t=5200-9400: discrete round prey condensates at bounded size (11 persistent prey tracks); predators are small droplets that dim between meals (0 persistent predator tracks)
observations.X: twin256 (seed 13, pred_on 0, same grid, duration and window): 79 static prey at the end, no swing; with predators (pack256/timeseries.png) prey 54 -> 5 -> 55 -> 19. Predators lower prey numbers and depend on them
observations.D: predators only: 14 persistent splits, generation 2 (pack256/lineage.png); fate.py: 7 of 66 predator daughters divide again; prey: 1 persistent split
observations.E: prey only: efork128 (seed 13, fork_t 6000) prey 16 -> 9 -> 2 -> 0 at t=6000/6200/6400/6600 with mean prey material 0.234 -> 0.233; fed128 keeps 16 and 16 at t=6200 and 6400

seeds_run.result: pass for X, predator D and prey E at 256^2 (D, X) and 128^2 (E); one swing, not cycles

verdicts.limitation: The capabilities sit in different kinds: predators divide (thinly) and are made only from prey material (their E is by construction), prey have the dynamical E but divide once in 12000 t with predators present (22 times without). Predator division is mostly fragmentation of fed bodies whose daughters starve: 38 of 66 daughters fade within a median 700 t and only 3 are seen to eat again, so sustained predator lineages are short (generation 2). Within 12000 t the populations make one lagged swing, not repeated cycles. Fork at 128^2 only; no dt/2 or grid variant run by me.
